authoredContract.concept: Ordinal-prefixed coordinate fragments hidden in prose reconstruct a legal generated chess game. Both sides finish with equal piece counts; the answer is the total remaining.
expectedSolvePath: Apply: Find valid fragments, sort by ordinal, replay under formal chess rules, and count pieces after the final legal move.
Separate constrained signal from generated noise.
Submit to server validation before the deadline.

hints.text: Some number-letter fragments are moves, and their leading numbers are not part of the board.
Sort candidate fragments by the leading ordinal, replay the remaining four-character coordinates under legal chess rules, then count all pieces still on the board.
